EmailTemplate.name: Application Received
EmailTemplate.subject: Your Wadhwani Grants application has been received
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Account.FirstName},
Thank you — your application for {!Account.WCF_Organizational_Name__c} has been submitted successfully.
Here’s what happens next:
1. Validation — our team checks that your submission is complete. 2. Review — once validated, your application is assessed by our review team. 3. Decision — we’ll write to you with the outcome and any next steps.
View your application: https://wadhwanifoundation--wfdev.sandbox.my.site.com/wcf/s/applicant-portal
Warm regards, The Wadhwani Grants Team
Wadhwani Grants — the grant-making arm of the Wadhwani Foundation.
Questions? [grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org](mailto:grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org)
